evidence: Path coverage for explanation on the compact graph, degree-matched: PPI 2-hop is non-zero for 47.15% of positives and 34.33% of negatives
metric: PPI 2-hop non-zero 47.15% of positives / 34.33% negatives; phenotype 9.13% / 6.50%; PPI+phenotype 18.17% / 14.55%; shared GO 86.7% / 82.2%; direct SVD AUC 0.6926; disease degree 0.5488
observation: Before committing to path-based explanations, the pilot's feature diagnostics measured how often each metapath is non-zero for positives versus negatives.
